profile.headline: Product & Growth Leader | Indiegogo Co-founder | Hands-on Builder | Data, Engineering & AI Agents
profile.summary:
I help startups figure out what to build, get it into customers’ hands, and understand what to do next. My work connects product, engineering, data, and growth, with responsibility for the outcome from the initial question through delivery and measurement.

I co-founded Indiegogo and spent 12 years building the business: first as the sole engineer, then establishing the data function, leading product, engineering, and design, and serving as GM of Crowdfunding. Along the way, I built the systems behind campaign discovery, personalization, marketing attribution, and automated email and site merchandising. I’ve led an organization of more than 20 people and built the product myself when the team was one.

At Great Question, my work spans onboarding and activation, research workflows, product analytics, pricing and billing, and marketing launches. I move between customer problems, product decisions, SQL, interface design, production code, and cross-team coordination. Recent examples include building analytics across two product generations, connecting marketing activity to signup, and creating an AI-assisted feedback loop that turns customer behavior and production evidence into prioritized improvements.

AI agents are central to how I build. I run multiple agents concurrently across implementation, review, and revision, using their work to test ideas and challenge proposed solutions. I own the product direction, resolve tradeoffs, and validate the result. This lets me carry more work from discovery through delivery while staying close to the details.

I do my best work in early-stage companies where an experienced builder can take responsibility wherever the business needs it: shaping a product, analyzing a funnel, leading a small team, building a growth system, or getting several functions aligned around a launch. I bring the judgment of a founder and the willingness to do the work directly.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Hands-on ownership across product, growth, analytics, and engineering for a customer-research platform. Lead cross-functional initiatives from problem definition and prioritization through implementation, rollout planning, and measurement.

• Led signup, onboarding, and study-template initiatives across the existing product and a new AI-enabled research platform, connecting acquisition intent to a useful first research experience.
• Defined and built product-analytics foundations, activation dashboards, and marketing-to-signup measurement. Used SQL, behavioral data, and production evidence to diagnose friction, validate metrics, and inform priorities.
• Built and operated an AI-assisted product-feedback loop that turns customer behavior and production signals into evidence-backed findings, prioritization, team routing, and reviewed software changes.
• Led billing-platform evaluation with Finance and built usage-capture, reconciliation, and entitlement foundations. Recommended pausing a vendor purchase when pricing assumptions changed, separating immediate financial-integrity needs from future monetization.
• Coordinated marketing-to-product launch work across Growth, Marketing, Product, Design, Platform, Support, and Operations, including authentication handoffs, attribution, consent, and launch-readiness criteria.
• Use multiple AI agents concurrently to implement, review, and revise software. Built supporting review and evaluation workflows while retaining responsibility for product decisions and delivery quality.
• Earlier work included architecture and delivery of external participant recruitment, addressing a top sales-team request and integrating recruitment providers into existing research workflows.

positions.title: Senior Data Engineer / Product Lead
positions.description:
Worked across product and data for an alternative-investment research and discovery platform.

• Rebuilt investment-scoring algorithms to support interest-based personalization across the website and email.
• Designed executive-dashboard infrastructure to make key business drivers visible and actionable.

positions.title: Chief Growth / Technology Officer
positions.description:
Connected growth, technology, and customer understanding at a clean-energy startup.

• Replatformed the marketing website so the Marketing team could manage content with less dependence on engineering.
• Built automated funnel analytics and introduced a customer-centered view of business performance to inform growth decisions.

positions.title: Co-Founder / CTO
positions.description:
Co-founded the crowdfunding platform and helped build the company across its first 12 years, moving from sole engineer to leadership across data, product, growth systems, and the crowdfunding business.

GM of Crowdfunding | 2018 - 2019
• Refocused the team on backers’ needs and championed a risk-based approach to campaign fulfillment.
• Rebuilt collaboration among Marketing, Sales, and Product through shared working groups; developed emerging leaders and strengthened the team’s use of OKRs.

Head of Product | 2015 - 2018
• Led a 20+ person organization across product, engineering, and design, translating customer and business needs into priorities and delivery.
• Built mechanisms for turning customer feedback into product improvements.
• Developed campaign classification and personalization systems, automated performance marketing across email and social, and site merchandising.

Head of Data | 2012 - 2015
• Established and scaled the Insights team across analytics, data infrastructure, and data science.
• Led development of the data warehouse, ETL pipeline, cross-channel attribution, and analytics infrastructure for experimentation and business decisions.
• Developed successive generations of campaign-ranking algorithms to surface trending content and support discovery.

Chief Technology Officer | 2007 - 2012
• Built the original platform as the sole engineer for more than three years.
• Grew the engineering, product, and design team from one to eight following seed funding.

positions.title: Senior Associate
positions.description:
• Led technology-organization design work and contributed to program-management structures and executive reporting.
• Analyzed customer and campaign data to identify targeting bias and assess the effects of policy and process changes on churn and payment behavior.

educations.schoolName: University of California, Berkeley, Haas School of Business
